summary: 第一人称射击战斗设计：射线与弹道、击杀时间、伤害衰减、后坐力模式、开镜灵敏度和延迟补偿命中。 Designs first-person shooter combat in any engine: hitscan vs projectiles, time-to-kill, damage falloff, recoil patterns, ADS sensitivity and lag-compensated hits. Use for a Doom- or Counter-Strike-like, or guns that feel weak or shots that do not register. Not for the camera rig (`camera-systems`), shake and hit-stop (`game-feel`) or raycast APIs (`godot-physics`, `unity-physics`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill fps-shooter，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for a Doom- or Counter-Strike-like, or guns that feel weak or shots that do not register.
Workflow: Name the reference shooter; Write every weapon as data; Shot model; Fire timing on a scheduled clock.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：camera-systems 用 gene_gdsk_camera_systems_v1，game-feel 用 gene_gdsk_game_feel_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
